letters.subject: Invoice AAP-7731: £320.00 over purchase order PO-4406
letters.body:
Hello Sara,

Thank you for invoice AAP-7731 dated 30 October 2026. It comes to £960.00 net against our purchase order PO-4406, which was for £640.00, so it is £320.00 over the agreed value.

Could you explain the extra £320.00, or send a corrected invoice? A reply by Monday 9 November would be very helpful.

Kind regards,
Office Administrator
Demo Fixings Ltd

letters.subject: Invoice BCS-11820: purchase order PO-4471 not recognised
letters.body:
Hello Phil,

We have received invoice BCS-11820 dated 22 October 2026 for £1,814.40. It quotes purchase order PO-4471, but we can't find that number on our purchase order list.

Could you check the order number and let us know the correct one, or send a corrected invoice, by Monday 9 November?

Kind regards,
Office Administrator
Demo Fixings Ltd

letters.subject: Invoice CBS-30922: £190.00 over purchase order PO-4404
letters.body:
Hello Gareth,

Thank you for invoice CBS-30922 dated 23 October 2026. With this invoice, the total invoiced against our purchase order PO-4404 comes to £6,440.00 net, which is £190.00 more than the £6,250.00 agreed.

Could you explain the extra £190.00, or send a corrected invoice? A reply by Monday 9 November would be appreciated.

Kind regards,
Office Administrator
Demo Fixings Ltd
